stock.title: Stock
stock.description: What is physically at each location, and every movement behind it.

openingStock.heading: Opening stock
openingStock.help: What this location already held when the system started counting. Entered once for each product, and corrected afterwards only through a stock correction.
openingStock.quantityHelp: Whole units only. Zero is a real answer if you counted and found none.
openingStock.noteHelp: Optional. For example who counted it.
openingStock.allEntered: Every product already has an opening stock figure at this location.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Who Free Ventures buys from. A supplier is switched off, never deleted, because past deliveries keep pointing at it.
suppliers.descriptionManager: Who Free Ventures buys from. Only a Director can add or switch off a supplier.
suppliers.name: Supplier name
suppliers.nameHelp: The name that will appear on every delivery from them.
suppliers.deactivateHelp: A supplier that is switched off cannot be chosen for a new delivery. Deliveries already recorded are not changed.

receiving.title: Supplier receiving
receiving.description: What arrived from a supplier, against what was expected. Stock rises only after a Manager approves.
receiving.noStockYet: Saving this does not change stock. A Manager must approve it first.
receiving.noSuppliers: Add a supplier before recording a delivery.
receiving.deliveryNoteHelp: From the supplier's own paperwork. This is one of the few things that has to be typed.
receiving.damageNoteHelp: Optional. Damaged goods are recorded and never added to stock.
receiving.entered: Delivery recorded. It is waiting for a Manager to approve it.
receiving.approveConsequence: Approving adds the accepted quantity to stock. This cannot be undone.
receiving.approved: Delivery approved. Stock has been updated.
receiving.rejected: Delivery rejected. Stock was not changed.
receiving.noSettled: No deliveries have been decided yet.

transfers.title: Internal transfers
transfers.description: Moving stock between the store, the warehouse and the yard. Balances change only after a Manager approves.
transfers.noStockYet: Saving this moves nothing. A Manager must approve it first.
transfers.noteHelp: Optional. For example what the stock is for.
transfers.entered: Transfer recorded. It is waiting for approval.
transfers.approveConsequence: Approving moves the stock now. This cannot be undone.
transfers.approved: Transfer approved. The stock has moved.
transfers.noSettled: No transfers have been decided yet.

adjustments.title: Stock corrections
adjustments.description: Correcting a figure that is wrong, or recording stock that went missing. A Manager records it and a Director approves it.
adjustments.noStockYet: Saving this changes nothing. A Director must approve it first.
adjustments.deltaHelp: Use a minus sign for stock that is missing, for example -5.
adjustments.reasonHelp: Required. Nothing else explains this movement.
adjustments.entered: Correction recorded. It is waiting for a Director to approve it.
adjustments.approveConsequence: Approving changes the stock figure now. This cannot be undone.
adjustments.approved: Correction approved. The stock figure has changed.
adjustments.noSettled: No corrections have been decided yet.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Customer orders, their quotations, and the invoices they became.
orders.proformaIsNotABill: This is a quotation, not a bill. Nothing is owed and no stock is held until the customer confirms.
orders.reservedHelp: The goods are still in the yard. They are held for this customer and cannot be sold to anyone else.
orders.confirmConsequence: Confirming holds the stock and creates the invoice. It cannot be undone; a mistake is cancelled and re-entered.
orders.confirmConsequenceCash: This is a walk-in sale. Confirming creates no invoice and holds no stock. Everything happens when the customer pays.
orders.confirmed: Confirmed. The invoice has been created and the stock is held.
orders.confirmedCashSale: Confirmed. Nothing is owed and no stock is held yet — a walk-in sale is completed at payment.
orders.created: Order created, and its quotation with it.
orders.revised: A new version of the quotation has been issued.
orders.reviseHelp: Change what the customer asked for. The version they already hold is kept.
orders.reviseConsequence: A new version of the quotation is issued and the earlier one is kept. Nothing is owed and no stock is held.
orders.cancelConsequenceConfirmed: Cancelling releases the stock held for this order and cancels its invoice. The invoice keeps its number and its history.
orders.cancelled: Order cancelled. Any held stock is available again.
orders.blockedByDiscount: A discount is waiting for a decision. It has to be settled first, because an invoice cannot be changed once it exists.
orders.blockedByExpiry: This quotation has expired. Issue a new version before the customer confirms.

customers.name: Customer name
customers.nameHelp: The name that will appear on their quotation and invoice.
customers.afterAdd: They will appear in the list above.

newOrder.description: Choose the customer, add what they want, and the totals work themselves out.
newOrder.noCustomerResults: No customer matches that. Add them below.
newOrder.cashCustomerHelp: A walk-in sale. Nothing is owed and no stock is held until it is paid for in full.
newOrder.empty: Search for a product to begin.
newOrder.noPrice: No price set — a Director must set one before this can be sold

invoice.creditIsNotMoney: Credit is an approved unpaid balance. It is not money received, so it does not change the status.

discount.requestedDirector: Sent to a Director for approval.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Invoices waiting for money, and what has already been settled.
payments.cashSalesHeading: Walk-in sales waiting to be paid ({count})
payments.cashSalesHelp: A walk-in sale has no invoice and holds no stock until it is paid. Everything happens in one action here.
payments.amountHelp: Whole shillings only. It is filled in with the balance due.
payments.settleConsequence: Marking it settled holds the goods for this customer and lets a storekeeper be assigned.
payments.cannotSettleYet: {outstanding} is still to be settled, by payment or approved credit.
payments.settled: Settled. The goods are held for this customer and a storekeeper can be assigned.
payments.completeCashSale: Take payment and complete the sale
payments.cashSaleConsequence: This takes the money, creates the invoice and holds the goods, all at once. If the stock has gone, nothing at all is recorded.
payments.cashSaleCompleted: Paid. The invoice is created and the goods are held for collection.
payments.cashSaleTitle: Take the money and complete the sale?
payments.cashSaleConfirmConsequence: This records {amount} received by {method}, creates the invoice and holds the goods for collection — all at once. If the stock has gone, nothing at all is recorded.

credit.heading: Credit
credit.recordsNoMoney: Credit is not a payment. It records an approved unpaid balance, and the invoice stays unpaid until money arrives.
credit.requestedManager: Sent to the Manager for approval.
credit.requestedDirector: Sent to a Director for approval.
credit.approveConsequence: This approves {amount} for {who} to pay later. It records no money, and the invoice stays unpaid until money arrives.
credit.beyondManagerLimit: This balance is beyond a Manager's limit, so only a Director can approve or reject it.
credit.approved: Credit approved. No money has been recorded.
credit.rejected: Credit rejected. The balance is still owed.

reversal.label: Reversal
reversal.requested: Sent to a Director. The money is still recorded until they decide.
reversal.approved: Reversed. The money received has gone back down.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.description: Goods that are paid for and waiting to go, and the signed notes that release them.
dispatch.nothingUnreleased: Nothing is waiting to be collected.
dispatch.nothingAwaitingAssignment: Nothing is waiting for a storekeeper.
dispatch.nothingAwaitingSignature: Nothing is waiting for a signature.
dispatch.noStorekeepers: Register a storekeeper before assigning a dispatch.
dispatch.assigned: Storekeeper assigned. No stock has moved.
dispatch.assignConsequence: Assigning does not move any stock. The goods stay where they are.
dispatch.noteNumberHelp: From the carbon-copy book. The system does not print dispatch notes, so this comes off the paper.
dispatch.noteRecorded: Note number saved. Nothing has moved yet.
dispatch.blockedByNote: Save the dispatch note number first. The release cannot be confirmed without it.
dispatch.releaseConsequence: Confirming means the customer has signed for the goods. The stock leaves the yard now, and this cannot be undone.
dispatch.released: Released. The stock has left the yard.
dispatch.releaseConfirmConsequence: This releases {count} units to {who} from {location}. The stock leaves the yard now, and this cannot be undone.

storekeepers.title: Storekeepers
storekeepers.description: The people who fetch and hand over goods. They do not sign in — the record exists so they can be named on a dispatch.
storekeepers.descriptionManager: The people who fetch and hand over goods. Only a Director can add or switch one off.
storekeepers.notAUser: A storekeeper has no login and no permissions. This is a record, not an account.
storekeepers.phoneHelp: Optional. Not used to sign in.
storekeepers.deactivateHelp: A storekeeper who is switched off cannot be assigned to a new dispatch. Past dispatches still name them.

production.title: Brick production
production.description: What each batch used, what came out of the mould, and what a Manager accepted after curing. Stock changes only on approval and on inspection.

enter.mouldedAtHelp: Curing counts from when moulding actually finished, not from now. Correct it if it was earlier.
enter.materialsHelp: Already filled in with the standard recipe. Change a figure only where the batch used something different.
enter.outsideRange: Outside the expected range. Say what happened below.
enter.yieldNoteHelp: Recorded with the batch. The figure is kept as counted either way.
enter.consequence: Saving records the batch. Nothing leaves the yard until a Manager approves it.

batch.entered: Batch recorded. Nothing has left the yard yet.
batch.approved: Approved. The materials are deducted and the bricks are curing.
batch.lotLine: {product}: {moulded} moulded, {rejected} thrown away at the mould
batch.approveConsequence: Approving takes the materials out of the yard and starts curing.

inspection.recorded: Inspection recorded. Only the accepted bricks are now for sale.

drafts.heading: Waiting for approval ({count})
drafts.none: No batch is waiting for approval.

curing.heading: Curing ({count})
curing.explanation: Bricks cure for 72 hours. Reaching the end of that does not make them sellable — a Manager has to inspect them and say how many were good.
curing.mustAccountForAll: {curing} cured and you have accounted for {offered}. The two must match.
curing.acceptedConsequence: Only the accepted bricks become available for sale.
curing.notYetReason: The 72 hours are not up yet. Inspection opens when they are.

settled.heading: Decided batches
settled.none: No batch has been decided yet.

imprest.title: Imprest funding
imprest.description: Requests for operating cash, what a Director approved and handed over, and what the Manager confirmed receiving.

total.label: Posted imprest funding
total.help: The sum of funding the Manager has confirmed receiving. It is not a cash count, and spending is not recorded here yet.
total.noFund: No imprest funding has been requested yet.

help.provide: May be less than the approval. To hand over more, record an approval increase first.

success.approved: Funding approved. Nothing is posted until the Manager confirms receipt.
success.provided: Handover recorded. It posts only when the Manager confirms it.
success.corrected: Corrected handover recorded. The Manager must confirm it.

detail.disputed: The Director recorded {provided}; the Manager counted {counted}.
detail.awaitingManager: Waiting for the Manager to confirm the handover or report a mismatch.
detail.awaitingDirector: Waiting for a Director to record the corrected handover.

imprestErrors.amount_too_large: That amount is larger than the system accepts.
imprestErrors.reason_required: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

imprestErrors.stale: This funding changed since you opened it. Reload to see the current handover.
imprestErrors.not_awaiting_decision: This request has already been decided.
imprestErrors.not_open_for_approval_change: The approval can only be increased before a handover or while a mismatch is open.
imprestErrors.not_awaiting_provision: A handover has already been recorded for this request.
imprestErrors.not_awaiting_receipt: There is no handover waiting for your confirmation.
